summary: All targeted features verified PASSING. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green (Settings GET defaults, PUT update+persist, max_turns clamp 2..20, test-ollama unreachable returns {ok:false} without 500, agent generate/seed/list, full battle: create -> 4 alternating turns with NO restart/greeting markers + rebuttal signal detected -> finish -> winner_id set, summary returned, battles_total/grudges_held both incremented, exactly one battles_won increment, meta-cognition rewrote about/persona/interests). The previously reported ObjectId-vs-string id bug is fixed (now find_one({'_id': agent_id}) with string ids throughout). Frontend: Discover renders roster (10 agents, monochrome brutalist style intact), options-outline icon navigates to /settings, Settings screen toggles cleanly between Emergent and Ollama (different field sets rendered), Test Connection against 127.0.0.1:9 shows 'FAILED ·' message (no UI crash), Save Settings persists and 'SAVED ✓' label shown, back button returns to Discover, Arena tab loads, enlisting two agents reveals START BATTLE button. Non-blocking: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' still present from a library.

minor.issue: Comparison 'winner_id == a["_id"] or str(winner_id) == str(a["_id"])' is now redundant since ids are strings; cosmetic cleanup only.

issues: Polished brutalist look, segmented provider toggle, stepper, intensity row all aligned. Touch targets >= 44pt.
Roster cards show updated stats (WON/GRUDGES/SEVERITY) after finished battles — confirms full E2E loop.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py llm_generate() correctly switches by settings.provider; primary vs secondary kind routed properly.

server.py next_turn() now builds a transcript of last 12 turns and explicitly quotes the opponent's last line — the change that fixes the 'fresh start' bug. Verified via heuristics in TestBattleContinuity.test_four_turns_continuity (no greeting/intro markers; rebuttal signal present).
server.py write_settings() correctly clamps max_turns to [2,20]; SettingsUpdate uses Optional fields so PUT is partial-friendly.
server.py test_ollama() returns {ok:false, error} for any httpx failure — 500 is avoided.
Frontend settings.tsx uses useFocusEffect to refetch each time — good. Save handler swallows errors silently; could surface a toast on failure (minor).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Discover, Settings nav+toggle+test-ollama+save+persist, Arena selection)

seed_data_creation: Roster already populated from previous iteration; tests reuse and add 1 generated agent + 1 finished battle. No manual reset required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If anything regresses, run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://roast-ring-1.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests/test_settings_and_continuity.py -v . The battle continuity check uses regex heuristics on turn text — if a model becomes more verbose it could false-positive; in that case loosen the restart_markers regex.
rca_of_issue: Original bug — battle felt like it restarted each turn — was caused by the prompt only giving the model the speaker's persona and not the running transcript or the opponent's last line. Refactored next_turn() now passes (a) full last-12-turn transcript, (b) explicit 'opponent's LAST line was X — fire back at THAT' instruction, (c) intensity-driven tone clause, and (d) explicit 'CONTINUE the existing argument — never restart, never reintroduce yourself, never greet'. Verified across 4 alternating turns: no greeting/self-intro markers and rebuttal signal (2nd-person address or shared vocabulary with previous turn) present.
